BROADCAST_OPTION: Tell the sprite about Scratch OS 1

kz2[JCr88^s7D@~`GRuW: Scratch OS 1 was the first ever Scratch OS which was made in 1989.
It only had very simple features like a movie player, a clock, a calendar, a cards game and a painting app.
When it first came out, it only cost $99 but people found out it was pretty good so they risen the price to $199.
Scratch OS 1 ended of support on the 14th October 1998.

BROADCAST_OPTION: Tell the sprite about Scratch OS 2

kz2[JCr88^s7D@~`GRuW: Scratch OS 2 was the sequel to Scratch OS 1.
It was made in 1991, 2 years after the release of Scratch OS 1.
It had more features like a photo and video editor, an improved video player, a 24-hour clock and an improved calendar.
When it came out, there was an update to Scratch OS 1 because of this.
Some people wanted to upgrade their computers from Scratch OS 1 to Scratch OS 2.
And it was the same with the more modern operating systems.
Scratch OS 2 ended of support on the 18th October 1999.

BROADCAST_OPTION: Tell the sprite about Scratch OS 3

kz2[JCr88^s7D@~`GRuW: Scratch OS 3 was released next.
It was made in 1994.
It had even more features like an improved clock, a startup and shutdown sounds and you could also access the internet.
It ended of support on the 12th January 2001.
This was the startup sound.
And this was the shutdown sound.

BROADCAST_OPTION: Tell the sprite about Scratch OS 4

kz2[JCr88^s7D@~`GRuW: Scratch OS 4 was a big success.
It was much better than the previous operating systems.
It was made in 1996.
It had a virus protection software,
An improved painting app and it also had retro games that you could play like Pacman, Frogger and Space Invaders.
It ended of support on 10th March 2008.
This was the startup sound.
And this was the shutdown sound.

BROADCAST_OPTION: Tell the sprite about Scratch OS 5

kz2[JCr88^s7D@~`GRuW: Scratch OS 5 is similar to Scratch OS 4 but it wasn't as good.
However, it did recieve many 4-star ratings.
It was made in 1998.
It had an improved virus protection software.
A painting app and other basic features like a clock, calendar and a racing game.
It ended of support on 11th April 2008.
This was the startup sound.
And this was the shutdown sound.

BROADCAST_OPTION: Tell the sprite about Scratch OS 6

kz2[JCr88^s7D@~`GRuW: Scratch OS 6 was a huge fail.
It received many 0-star ratings.
It was made in 1999.
The only thing that was improved in Scratch OS 6, was the racing game and it was majorly improved.
This got people hyped and decided to buy Scratch OS 6.
However, just a few seconds after you open the game, it crashes.
The virus protection software was also terrible because it could only get rid of a certain computer virus.
In the year 2000, it won The Worst Operating System of the Year Award.
Because of this, the head officer of Scratch OS was fined $10000.
Fortunately, Scratch OS 6 ended of support on 22nd May 2003.
Four years after it's release.
This was the startup sound.
And this was the shutdown sound.

BROADCAST_OPTION: Tell the sprite about Scratch OS 7

kz2[JCr88^s7D@~`GRuW: Scratch OS 7 was a huge success.
It was so much better than Scratch OS 6.
It was made in 2002.
It had so many improved features.
The only thing that wasn't improved, was the racing game because it got majorly improved in Scratch OS 6.
And you probably guessed this correctly, the racing game didn't crash at all.
In 2003, Scratch OS 7 won The Best Operating System of the Year Award.
It ended of support on 31st December 2016.
This was the startup sound.
And this was the shutdown sound.

BROADCAST_OPTION: Tell the sprite about Scratch OS 8

kz2[JCr88^s7D@~`GRuW: Scratch OS 8 is similar to Scratch OS 7 but it wasn't as good.
However, it did recieve many 4-star ratings like Scratch OS 5.
It was made in 2005.
It had an improved virus protection software.
A painting app and other basic features like a video and photo editor, a calendar and an improved video player.
It ended of support on 26th July 2015.
This was the startup sound.
And this was the shutdown sound.

BROADCAST_OPTION: Tell the sprite about Scratch OS 9

kz2[JCr88^s7D@~`GRuW: Scratch OS 9 was made in 2008.
In this operating system, you could change the background of the computer and the sounds.
And it was also pretty unstable but not as unstable as Scratch OS 6.
It ended of support on 2nd February 2014.
This was the startup sound.
And this was the shutdown sound.

BROADCAST_OPTION: Tell the sprite about Scratch OS 10

kz2[JCr88^s7D@~`GRuW: Scratch OS 10 is the most successful operating system of all time.
All of the features were upgraded and improved, even the racing game.
It was made in 2009.
It won The Best Operating System of the Year Award five times in a row!
It still hasn't ended of support but it will end of support in 29th September 2026.
This was the startup sound.
And this was the shutdown sound.

BROADCAST_OPTION: Tell the sprite about Scratch OS 11

kz2[JCr88^s7D@~`GRuW: Scratch OS 11 had the biggest improvements in any of the Scratch OS computers.
The background was improved, the sounds were improved, you name it!
It was made in 2013.
It still hasn't ended of support but it will end of support in 7th November 2024.
This was the startup sound.
And this was the shutdown sound.

BROADCAST_OPTION: Tell the sprite about Scratch OS 12

kz2[JCr88^s7D@~`GRuW: Scratch OS 12 is our most recent, our fastest and our most up to date operating system.
It was made in 2018.
It still hasn't ended of support but it will end of support in 7th November 2030.
This was the startup sound.
And this was the shutdown sound.
